name: Youngstown State University
tuition_note: In-state (Ohio resident) undergraduate tuition & fees $11,717 for 2026-27 from official YSU Cost of Attendance page (ysu.edu/financial-aid-and-scholarships/cost-of-attendance). Housing $12,000/academic year is the 2026-27 Fall Cohort Promise & Legacy residence hall rate (Kilcawley/Lyden/Wick/Cafaro) from official YSU Housing Rates 2026-27 PDF; this is room + board (includes full meal plan) - YSU does not publish a room-only rate for standard undergraduate residence halls (only Weller apartments for grad students/families offer room-only).
